turns.tutor:
Hello! Let's talk about finished actions.
Look at this example. I walk to work every day. Yesterday I walked to work. I added -ed because the action is finished.
Rule: for a finished action, add -ed to a regular verb.
Right: "I walked to work yesterday." Wrong: "I walk to work yesterday."
Your turn. Write the verb in the past: "Last week my friend ___ (call) me."
